title: Balancing a fission reaction
caption: Nucleon and proton numbers must balance: 235 + 1 = 141 + 92 + 3 and 92 = 56 + 36, so three neutrons are released. The products are lighter by 0.186 u, about 170 MeV, and the extra neutrons can sustain a chain reaction.
alt: Reaction: uranium-235 plus a neutron gives barium-141, krypton-92 and three neutrons, releasing about 170 MeV.
description: A: 236 on each side. Z: 92 on each side.
Q from atomic masses: 173 MeV, most of it the kinetic energy of the two fragments.
